sendPage.message: Send this page to Video Grabber…

sendLink.message: Send this link to Video Grabber…

selectionExpired.message: This selection expired or was already opened. Right-click the page or link again.

shortcutSettingsUnavailable.message: Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts to change the shortcut.

existingHint.message: Saved files were found. Check format and quality in Library before choosing. Another copy keeps the originals.

extensionDescription.message: Send the current video or music page to your local Video Grabber queue.

sourceHint.message: Best available source audio, without re-encoding. The source determines the format.

multipleApps.message: Multiple apps found. Check the save folder before downloading.

singleItem.message: Single item only. No playlist or subtitles. Video covers saved when available.

openApp.message: Open Video Grabber on this computer, then click Reconnect.

unsupportedPage.message: Switch to an HTTP or HTTPS video or music page, then open this extension again.

invalidConnection.message: Only the local app at 127.0.0.1 can be connected.

invalidFormat.message: Choose video, MP3 or source audio.

invalidRequest.message: Reopen the extension and try again.

extensionAccessOff.message: Turn on "Allow the Chrome extension to connect" in Video Grabber under Settings and help, then click Reconnect.

notOurApp.message: This address did not return a valid Video Grabber app.

appUnavailable.message: Cannot connect. Open Video Grabber and click Reconnect.

downloadUnconfirmed.message: Could not confirm the download. Check the app queue before trying again.

downloadFailed.message: The app could not add this download.

openQueueFailed.message: Could not open the queue. Use the app's tray menu.

added.message: Added to the app queue. You can keep browsing.

duplicate.message: This download is already in the queue.

settingsNotSaved.message: Could not remember your choices. You can still use the extension.

destinationChanged.message: The app's save folder changed. Click Reconnect and confirm the folder before downloading.
